         amb3 :'https://sound-effects-media.bbcrewind.co.uk/mp3/NHU05014211.mp3'})
samples ({amb4 : 'voice/Audio 2.mp3'},'github:edcrub/samp/main/')

await initHydra()
solid(0,0,0,.7)
.out()

const cpmVal = 60/4
const sampLen = 25            
const cycles = 2

cpm(cpmVal)

const cycleSec = 60 / cpmVal  
const frac = (cycles * cycleSec) / sampLen   

_amb1  : s("amb1").begin(0).end(frac).gain(.125).room(1)
_amb2  : s("amb2").begin(0).end(frac).delay(3, 1/16,.2).room(2).gain(.12)
_amb3  : s("amb3").begin(0).end(frac).delay(3, 1/16,.2).room(2).gain(.12)
amb4  : s("amb4").begin(0).end(frac).echo(2,1/8,.7).bpf(2500).gain(6)
.scope()
